hero.paragraph: Ka tukuna e HydroLedger ki ngā hapori whare ngā raraunga whakamahinga tūturu, te nama utu tiritahi mārama, me ngā whakamōhiotanga turuturu wawe — katoa i runga i te papatohu kotahi.
hero.panelSub: 8% i raro i te toharite o te whare

trustBar.label: E whakawhirinakihia ana e ngā rōpū whakahaere whare maha

features.headingPrefix: Ngā mea katoa e hiahiatia ana hei
features.paragraph: Poroporoaki ki ngā utu tiritahi ōrite. Ka whakatairanga a HydroLedger i te ōritetanga mā te ine tika me te aunoatanga mātau.

items.title: Inenga-iti Wā Tūturu
items.text: Inehia te whakamahinga wai tika, ia meneti, ki ia waeine, kaua e whakawhirinaki ki ngā whakatau tata tawhito.

items.title: Nama Hapori Aunoa
items.text: Te whakaputa nama ki ngā kainoho e hono tika ana ki te whakamahinga. Whakakorea te taumahatanga o te nama inamata.

items.title: Whakamōhiotanga Turuturu Wawe
items.text: Ko ngā whakamōhiotanga aunoa e tohu ana i ngā tauira rerenga rerekē me te hopu i ngā kino wai nui i roto i ngā meneti, kaua i ngā marama.

items.title: Tohaina Utu Tika
items.text: Aroturukitia te whakamahinga o ngā wāhi tiritahi me te toha i ngā utu hanganga mā te mārama hei hanga i te whakawhirinaki me te tiaki.

howItWorks.heading: Tāutanga māmā, Whakahaere Māmā
howItWorks.paragraph: Kia tere te whakarite. Ina hono ngā taputapu, mā te papanga e whakahaere ngā tātai uaua, te tuku nama, me ngā whakamōhiotanga turuturu.

steps.title: Honoa ngā Mita Mātau
steps.text: Ka whakapirihia e ā mātou kaitoi tohu ngā mita rerenga mātau ki ngā takirere o ia waeine i raro i te 15 meneti.

steps.title: Aroturuki Wā Tūturu
steps.text: Ka rere tonu ngā raraunga ki te papanga kapua o HydroLedger, e hopu ana i ngā whakamahinga tika me te aroturuki i ngā mahi rerekē.

steps.title: Whakaaunoatia ngā Nama
steps.text: I te mutunga o te marama, ka whakakotahihia e te pūnaha ngā tohanga o ngā wāhi tiritahi me ngā rōrahi i inea hei nama mārama.

portalPreview.headingPrefix: Whakamana i ngā Kainoho me te
portalPreview.paragraph: Ko te māramatanga e hanga ana i te kotahitanga. Ka pai ngā kainoho ki ngā papatohu māmā me te urupare wā tūturu, ngā matapae utu, me ngā whakatūpato turuturu.
portalPreview.tipText: Kei te whakaatu tō tapu kīhini i te rerenga tonu i te ata. Ma te tirotiro i ngā aerator ka penapena pea tae atu ki te 10 karanene ia wiki.
portalPreview.autopayLabel: Te rā Utu Aunoa e whai ake nei

audienceSplit.residentHeading: Ngā Utu Ratonga Tika, e Hāngai ana ki te Whakamahinga
audienceSplit.residentParagraph: Kati te utu mō te whakamahinga nui a tō hoa tata. Utua noa te wai e whakamahia ana e koe, e tautokona ana e ngā raraunga papatohu wā tūturu.
residentBullets: Ngā raraunga inenga-iti ā-marama tika me ngā inenga utu mārama.
Ngā whakamōhiotanga SMS & pūkoro mēnā ka kitea ngā turuturu iti i roto i ngā taputapu.
He pūnaha utu nama matihiko māmā me ngā rīhiti aunoa.
audienceSplit.adminHeading: ROI Whakahaere Inamata me te Mana Whakamau Para
audienceSplit.adminParagraph: Whakahurihia te whakahaere ratonga mai i te raruraru utu nui ki te rerenga mahi māeneene me te nama kainoho aunoa.
adminBullets: Te toha ratonga māmā e hono tika ana ki ngā waeine takitahi.
Ngā whakamōhiotanga whakahaere inamata hei ārai i ngā kino wai utu nui.
Te pūrongo papatohu taipitopito mō te nama mita matua vs. ngā karanene kua tohatohahia.

pricing.heading: Ngā Utu Whakahaere Whakahoki-Mononga Nui
pricing.paragraph: Kōwhiria he mahere e hāngai ana ki tō hapori. I te nuinga o te wā, ka utu a HydroLedger i ōna ake utu papanga i te marama tuatahi mā te whakaiti i te para o ngā wāhi tiritahi.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.desc: He tino pai mō ngā rōpū whare iti e hiahia ana ki ngā pūkenga inenga-iti matua.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.desc: Tō mātou mōkī koura mō ngā hapori whare e hiahia ana ki te nama kainoho aunoa.
features: Ngā mea katoa i roto i te Starter
tiers.cta: Haere ki te Pro (E tino hiahiatia ana)

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.desc: Mō ngā hapori nui e hiahia ana ki ngā rerenga API ritenga me ngā whirihoranga nama.
features: Ngā mea katoa i roto i te Professional
tiers.cta: Whakapā atu ki te Hoko Enterprise

testimonials.pill: Ngā Mea Tūturu o te Whakahaere
testimonials.heading: Ko tā ngā Kaiwhakahaere Rawa

quotes.text: I huri ke a HydroLedger i tō mātou P&L whakahaere. I kitea e mātou e toru ngā turuturu nui i ngā raina mīhini i penapena neke atu i te ₹11 lakh i tō mātou hauwhā tuatahi.
Kua piki te whakawhirinaki o ngā kainoho. Ko te nama i ā mātou kairīhi i runga i te whakamahinga wai, kaua i ngā tātai mita matua, i whakaoti i ngā tautohetohe tino mamae.

faq.heading: Ngā Pātai e Auau Ana te Pātai

items.q: Me kati rānei te ratonga mīhini mō ngā mita-iti mātau?
items.a: Kāore. Ka uru ngā waeine mita mātau ki runga i ngā raina o mua. Ka oti te tāutanga i roto i ngā meneti me te kore e motu te ratonga.

items.q: Me pēhea te tātai i ngā utu wai tiritahi?
items.a: Ka tangohia te puna wāhi tiritahi matua (hei tauira, puna kaukau) i ngā mita matua i te tuatahi. Ka toha ngā rōpū rawa i aua utu i runga i te tika.

items.q: He pēhea te tere o HydroLedger ki te kite i ngā rerenga turuturu tonu?
items.a: Ka tirohia e ā mātou pūnaha whakamōhio ngā tohu rerenga. Ki te kore te rerenga e tae ki te kore i roto i te huringa 10-meneti, ka tukuna inamata he whakatūpato.

items.q: Kei te whakahaere a HydroLedger i te haumarutanga, te tūmataiti kainoho rānei?
items.a: Āe. Ka tiakina e HydroLedger ngā tautuhi pūhara kainoho i muri i ngā hongere whakamunatia. Ka puritia ngā raraunga whakahaere mō te aroturuki whakamahinga anake.

cta.pill: Hono mai ki a HydroLedger i tēnei rā
cta.heading: Tīmata te Aroturuki i tō Whakamahinga Wai i Tēnei Rā
cta.paragraph: Whakanuia ngā inenga tiaki, whakangāwari i te taumahatanga o te nama kainoho, me te tiaki i ngā hanganga maha. Tukuna mātou ki te tātai i tō ROI hapori.

footer.tagline: Ngā rerenga toha ratonga mātau me ngā rongoā inenga-iti kainoho wā tūturu. Tiakina ngā pūnaha, whakatairitea ngā nama, tiakina te wai.
